name: micro-momentum-landing
description: A simple landing page about tiny high-performance habits.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-hero.js && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html styles.css script.js dist/ && cp -R assets dist/assets
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name micro-momentum-landing --branch main
